_comment: The ratchet baseline for verify_rules.py on THIS repo's own corpus (enforcement/README.md, decision 2). The count may only fall; the verifier fails the commit when it rises, and fails when it falls until this number is lowered in the same commit. Past the deadline any gap fails. Only a person moves the deadline, and the move is recorded under 'moves' with who and why.
by: Fable (E1.7 + E2.1 + E2.2 merged) — every reference resolves: the scanner and its built-ins, the linter configs, the pre-push runner with its tools, the commit-msg and Claude Code session hooks; the gap count is zero and the ratchet now only guards against a rise

moves.why: E0.3 added 92 rules (DRY-1..7, L-1..12, DES-1..4 in the five app documents), each naming a scanner signature, tool or hook that E1/E2 build; no existing rule lost its check. The deadline did not move.
